rationale: The discussion has clarified the package elements, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and the state still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors insist those options remain available if needed. Positions have hardened into a stable impasse over the same red lines across the last two rounds, so further free-form rounds are likely to circle without substantive movement unless a mediator forces a quantified trade-off framework.
